text: Capital Garden Hotel - Khách sạn Vườn Thủ Đô Home Rooms & Rates Hotel Service Contact News and Event English 简体中文 ( Chinese (Simplified) ) Tiếng Việt ( Vietnamese ) 日本語 ( Japanese ) Giới thiệu Home > Giới thiệu Hotline: 098.731.8899 No. 4 Hoang Ngoc Phach Street, Lang Ward, Hanoi City, Vietnam Language Book Now Home About us Rooms & Rates hotel services Gallery Contact Located in the central area, near the National Cinema Center (NCC), only a 15-minute drive from the city center, a 30-minute drive from Noi Bai airport, Capital Garden hotel is an ideal stopover. of domestic and foreign tourists on every trip or trip with friends and family. Nestled in a quiet street, Capital Garden is the perfect place to relax after stressful working hours. Every year, the hotel welcomes thousands of people, most of whom are Japanese customers who come to work long-term in Vietnam. At Capital Garden Hotel, customers can easily move to entertainment locations such as Indira Gandhi Park, National Cinema Center, Royal Park City Shopping Center… The hotel has a total of 72 rooms with 04 room types: Superior, Deluxe, Executive and Suite In operation since 1994, Capital Garden Hotel always makes a deep impression on customers thanks to its professional, enthusiastic and experienced staff. In addition, Capital Garden Hotel always satisfies customers thanks to its rich utility services. When coming to Capital Garden hotel, customers will be able to use free Internet/wifi services. Transportation and shuttle service by luxury 4-seat, 7-seat, 12-seat car to your door according to customer’s request. In particular, the favorite address of many tourists when coming to Capital Garden hotel is Vuon Thu Do Restaurant. Pho Vuon Thu Do is famous in Hanoi for its Asian and European dishes meticulously prepared by chefs, giving diners unique and interesting experiences. Besides room service, the hotel is also a reputable address providing meeting and dinner party services for families, companies and businesses. Not only is the sophisticated and modern decoration wonderful, but diners are also satisfied with the taste of delicious dishes, carefully prepared by the chef. Capital Garden Hotel has been in operation since 1994 under investment license number: 817/GP dated March 4, 1994 and adjustment license number: March 4, 1994. 1546/UB – QL dated August 13, 2004 adjusting investment license No. 1546/UB – QL According to Decision No. 06/UB-QL dated January 18, 1995 by the State and Investment Cooperation Committee (now is the Ministry of Planning and Investment) granted and operating in the form of a joint stock company since 2017 with the majority of shares belonging to Ho Chi Minh City Construction Company.
